stories.title: Mike Vrabel emerged from his offseason scandal. Its effects linger
stories.summary: Mike Vrabel and the New England Patriots moved past the Dianna Russini scandal. Others are still feeling its effects.

stories.title: Tua to start, but Falcons mum on QB after Week 1
stories.summary: Tua Tagovailoa will be the starting quarterback for the Falcons against the Steelers in Week 1.

stories.title: U-M coach gives Underwood tepid backing as QB1
stories.summary: Michigan will continue to start Bryce Underwood at quarterback despite struggles in the season opener, coach Kyle Whittingham said Monday.

stories.title: No. 9 Ole Miss squeaks by Louisville on late FG
stories.summary: Lucas Carneiro kicked a 48-yard field goal as time expired to give ninth-ranked Mississippi a 41-38 victory over No. 24 Louisville on Sunday night.

stories.title: Indiana loses RB Martin until at least midseason
stories.summary: Indiana running back Khobie Martin will be out until midseason with an arm injury, coach Curt Cignetti said Monday.
